description: External chase-camera view from just behind and above a Skipjack-class ship (landing gear down) docked on a landing pad of a ground starport at night, with the base's lit city skyline around the pad, the flight HUD (altitude/vertical-speed readouts at bottom right, set launch speed beside the reticle) and the hull/shield/pressure gauges in the lower-left. The ship undocks with the station's fixed-speed launch and is followed by the camera as it leaves the pad and climbs.
scenario: Player-controlled Skipjack docked at Cydonia Base (a ground station of the 'new_ground' type on Mars, system path 0,0,0,0,18, docked on its first pad) in the task's buggy build, external camera, undocking with the station's standard fixed-speed (2 m/s) launch. Recorded headlessly (Xvfb + llvmpipe) and retimed so the clip runs at in-game speed (HUD clock 00:00:08 to 00:00:25).
